highlights: The Future of Charging Has Arrived in Sri Lanka. Meet the Power of 25W Qi2.
UGREEN Sri Lanka proudly introduces the PB773 Magflow Power Bank, the nation’s first power bank featuring the revolutionary 25W Qi2 wireless charging standard.
Engineered for the latest generation of smartphones, this power bank delivers a significantly faster, more efficient, and perfectly aligned charge every time.
Step up from standard wireless charging and embrace the future of power with UGREEN.
Groundbreaking 25W Qi2 Wireless Charging: As the new universal standard, Qi2 unlocks true 25W wireless fast charging, offering a substantial power increase over previous generations.
Power up your compatible device from 0 to 50% in a fraction of the time.
Perfect Magnetic Alignment with Magflow: Experience the convenience of strong, precision-engineered magnets that instantly snap the power bank onto your MagSafe or Qi2 compatible device.
This secure connection ensures uninterrupted and highly efficient charging, whether you are stationary or on the move.

High-Capacity 10000mAh Battery: Keep your devices powered throughout the day. With a robust 10000mAh capacity, the PB773 provides multiple full charges for most flagship smartphones, making it an essential companion for travel, work, or daily use.
Versatile Dual-Device Charging: The PB773 is more than just a wireless charger. Its powerful USB-C port allows you to fast-charge a second device simultaneously.
Power your smartphone wirelessly while conveniently topping up your earbuds or another device with a cable.
